main_idea: On-policy distillation lifts GDPval net win-loss margin to about 21% on two model families
ideas: Same recipe works across Nemotron and Qwen
Net win-loss margin vs. base is about +21%
Training data excludes public GDPval eval
Pipeline: real tasks, student generates, teacher scores
Mean rubric score gains of 5.1 and 7.9 points
summary: Clutter is the slogan headline, eyebrow tag, pipeline diagram, and secondary rubric row; the net-margin figures and footnote are complete and clear.
